in_sanskrit.name: तोषी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is constantly wishing, desiring, or longing for something.

in_hindi.name: तोषी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is constantly desiring or wishing for something. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word तोष (toṣa), which means 'desire, wish, or longing'.

in_tamil.name: தொஷி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who brings joy, delight, or happiness to others. The name Toshi in Tamil is derived from the Tamil word தோஷம் (tōśam), which means 'joy, delight, or happiness'.

in_telugu.name: తోశి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is constantly desiring or wishing for something. The name Toshi in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit word तोष (toṣa), which means 'desire, wish, or longing'.
